examples.task_text:
Find the fully factored form of the 5th derivative of the polynomial
$P(x) = \frac{x^{8}}{6720} + \frac{x^{7}}{280} - \frac{49 x^{6}}{720} - \frac{147 x^{5}}{40}$.

Find the fully factored form of the 5th derivative of the polynomial
$P(x) = \frac{x^{8}}{6720} - \frac{x^{7}}{168} + \frac{7 x^{6}}{80} - \frac{27 x^{5}}{40}$.

Find the fully factored form of the 5th derivative of the polynomial
$P(x) = \frac{x^{10}}{30240} - \frac{11 x^{9}}{15120} - \frac{x^{8}}{105} + \frac{37 x^{7}}{315} + \frac{x^{6}}{3} - \frac{42 x^{5}}{5}$.

Find the fully factored form of the 5th derivative of the polynomial
$P(x) = \frac{x^{10}}{30240} - \frac{x^{9}}{2160} - \frac{13 x^{8}}{448} + \frac{5 x^{7}}{8} + \frac{93 x^{6}}{40} - \frac{567 x^{5}}{5}$.
